purpose: Bounded retrospective closure of the existing readout-diagnostics story; no new research branch, training, or inference.
model_scope: SC-INR is the user's LTE-derived experimental variant, not an independent model family. Native absolute paired comparison is restricted to these existing checkpoints and fixed study cohort.
analysis_status: All evaluation data and original scores have already been seen. This is retrospective analysis of the complete frozen cohort, not a new prospective test. No result-dependent case deletion or configuration tuning.

metrics.clip: Clip each saved reference and native endpoint to [0,1] before output interpolation; ground truth unchanged. This is NOT clipping each interpolated raw output. Bands are projected after endpoint transform and spatial crop.
metrics.band_projection: RGB Chebyshev FFT bands, DC excluded; full cropped spatial mean square; band dB is a band-MSE ratio, not ordinary full-image PSNR

primary_curves.groups: each model x scale x reference x {rgb,b1,b2,b3}, two seeds pooled descriptively with equal image weight
primary_curves.counts: original negatives strictly rescued (gain>1e-8); original positives becoming negative (gain<-1e-8); all records worse than native (mse-native_mse>1e-8)
primary_curves.oracle: exact group coefficient clip(mean(a)/mean(b),0,1), plus per-case coefficients; both HR-informed posterior descriptive ceilings, not deployable tuning or test-set selected proposed methods

robustness: Six fixed endpoint/crop conventions; full rows and per-band counts, mean dB, magnitude thresholds, exact global/per-case oracle and half-step loss. Report every convention; no best-metric selection.
native_comparison: Per scale and seed, native absolute RGB PSNR of LTE and SC-INR; paired SC minus LTE. Also first average the two seed PSNRs within each image, then report 32-image mean, win/tie/loss counts and percentile image-cluster bootstrap. Seed records are not independent images.

bootstrap.unit: 32 image IDs, reused jointly for all models/seeds/scales/conventions
bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 95%, descriptive and not multiplicity adjusted

examples.median: for each model x overshoot/direction, choose record nearest median RGB PSNR loss, tie break image then seed then scale; empty class remains missing
examples.tail: for each model choose largest RGB PSNR loss, tie break image then seed then scale; explicitly tail example; may overlap median
examples.output: selection metadata only; image panels can be rendered by parent without reselection

budget.resume: prohibited; deadline fixed in budget.json at first approved launch

integrity: Validate all 256 prediction hashes against original frozen manifest and all 32 truth hashes before loading pixels; source+protocol SHA frozen at launch; preserve original inputs, outputs, logs, failures; incomplete run not success. Revised analysis source requires new version/root after execution.
